hook: About 20 new Rust GUI toolkits since 2022

beats.say: Raph Levien has followed up his advice for the next dozen Rust GUIs, written four and a half years ago. Roughly 20 toolkits have been announced since.
He argues Rust UI is still compelling: cross-platform apps are often slow, platform toolkits have stagnated, Electron keeps spreading, and RAM is expensive.
Few flagship apps use Rust for UI yet, but Zed's GPUI proves it ships, and it is emerging as a top choice for AI-driven rewrites, notably at Discord.
